title: Tags, cost allocation and the resource nobody owns

videos.script: The bill says what each resource cost. It does not say whose it is. {{whose}} A tag does: a name and a value on a resource, such as team equals shop. Cost Management groups the bill by it. {{tag}} Tags only work if every resource has one. So a policy puts them there, and refuses the resource group that tries to start without one. {{policy}} Then a query over the cost export finds what is left: the spend nobody owns. {{end}}
